title: Senior C++ Software Engineer
text:
Department: Development

Location: Wroclaw

Description

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the COM Development team and play a key role in the development, maintenance, and modernization of the Infor COM solution. This position is ideal for an experienced software engineer with strong C++ expertise who enjoys working with complex enterprise applications, solving challenging technical problems, and contributing to the long-term evolution of a mature business-critical product.

About The Team

The COM Development team is responsible for delivering and maintaining a long-established enterprise solution used by customers worldwide. The team is actively modernizing the product while ensuring stability and continuity for existing installations. As a senior engineer, you will have a direct impact on technical decisions, product quality, and the future direction of the COM platform.

A Typical Day In The Life Includes



- Design, develop, and maintain core components of the Infor COM solution.
- Implement new functionality and enhancements in close collaboration with Product Owners, Consulting, Support, QA, and other Development teams.
- Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into robust software solutions.
- Develop and maintain high-quality code in C++ and Java.
- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
- Investigate and resolve complex customer-reported issues and product defects.
- Contribute to modernization initiatives, including technology upgrades, platform migrations, and architectural improvements.
- Drive continuous improvements in software quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
- Support automated testing and CI/CD initiatives.

Basic Qualifications



- Several years of professional software development experience.
- Strong hands-on experience with C++ development in complex software systems.
- Good knowledge of Java and object-oriented software development principles.
- Experience working with large, mature codebases and enhancing existing software while maintaining backward compatibility.
- Experience modernizing legacy applications and refactoring software without disrupting business-critical functionality.
- Experience with multithreaded applications and performance optimization.
- Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
- Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and debugging techniques.
- Experience with source control systems, build pipelines, and modern development practices.
- Experience working in Agile development environments.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with large-scale enterprise or ERP applications.
- Experience with modernization projects involving legacy systems.
- Experience with Java 21 and modern Java development practices.
- Familiarity with REST APIs, integration technologies, and distributed systems.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
- Experience mentoring less experienced engineers.
- Familiarity with manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, or supply chain business processes.

About Infor

Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next.

Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry specific markets. Infor builds complete industry suites in the cloud and efficiently deploys technology that puts the user experience first, leverages data science, and integrates easily into existing systems. title: Global Business Applications CSV and Test Management Lead
text:
Job Purpose

This is a great opportunity to apply your leadership and expertise in pursuit of our mission to become the most customer-focused and innovative oral care company in the world. We are seeking an experienced CSV and Test Management Lead to drive the delivery of validated software solutions like SAP, Salesforce and other enterprise Applications and enable Global Test Management and capabilities for Straumann’s Global Business Applications department. The ideal candidate will bring deep CSV and Test Management expertise for Enterprise Business Applications like SAP, etc.

As part of our digital transformation journey and business growth strategy, you will play a key role in contributing to major initiatives across the organization. You will report to the Head of Global Business Applications Processes, Toolchain, and Delivery.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities



-  Manage and review all levels of validation documentation (internal or external SDLC) in collaboration with all stakeholders

Including Validation (Strategy) & Test Plans, User Requirements, Functional, Configuration, Installation Specifications, SOP’s and Qualification Documents like Test Specifications & records. Traceability Matrices, Risk Analysis, Validation Reports, etc.



-  Provide implementation or update project teams with computerized systems validation (CSV) guidance
-  Continuous Improvement of CSV standards, considering best practices and regulatory changes to maintain compliance and improve validation processes in alignment with IT and QA departments.
-  Key role for defining, driving and implementation of Test Management for Business Application and other major initiatives like S/4HANA in alignment with Application Lifecycle Management Strategy
-  Partner with Quality Assurance, Test Management and Compliance teams to align deliverables as CSV guidelines
-  Coordinate local CSV and QA representatives to fulfill global CSV Compliance requirements.
-  Provide Training, guidance and coaching to all stakeholders for CSV standards, Test approaches
-  Collaborate with functional teams in IT across SAP and other Business Application stakeholders and all relevant business representatives to ensure compliance and/or project quality.
-  Participate in internal and external audits if needed.

Requirements Needed

Education 



-  Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Systems, QM or related field and/or related working experience.

Experience & Personal Attributes



-  10+ years of experience in CSV, QM, Test and Project Management, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.
-  Strong expertise in GxP requirements and guidelines like 21 CFR Part 11 regulations, GAMP 5 and Annex11 requirements for computerized systems.
-  Understanding, adapting and establishing GxP regulations, CSV and documentation best practices in regulated industries.
-  Strong Project- & Test management skills with the ability to adapt also solution-oriented compliance deliverables
-  Familiar with several software development methodologies and the capability to adapt them for CSV
-  Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the organization and with external partners.
-  Capacity to face and adapt to challenges to overcome them (resilience)
-  Fluent English spoken and written, other languages are an asset (DE)

Work location Straumann Group offices in Madrid/Wroclaw - Hybrid, with 2 remote working days/week.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

title: Senior Test Automation Engineer (Freelance) - Wrocław
text:

Hi! We are Monterail. A team of :130 developers, designers, QAs and other technology professionals building innovative software everyday. We work with clients around the globe. We've helped businesses of all sizes develop outstanding digital products.

- Proven track record designing and building test automation frameworks from the ground up
- Demonstrable experience leveraging AI coding agents, or genuine enthusiasm to adopt and master them quickly
- Solid knowledge of git and version control practices in a team environment
- Strong understanding of the DOM and how to write reliable, maintainable locator strategies
- Experience with defect tracking tools (e.g. Jira) and test management tools (e.g. TestRail)
- Ability to communicate technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience with usability and accessibility testing
- Experienced working within Agile/Scrum teams
- English proficiency 
- Friendly, supportive, positive, can-do attitude

Nice to have

- A love of travel!

title: Intern QA Engineer
text:
Ryanair Labs are currently recruiting for an Intern QA Engineer to join Europe’s Largest Airline Group!

This is a very exciting time to join Ryanair as we look to expand our operation to 800 aircraft and 300 million guests within the next 10 years.

Ryanair Labs is the technology brand of Ryanair. Labs is a state of-the-art digital & IT innovation hub creating Europe’s Leading Travel Experience for our customers.

We are launching a 3 month full-time paid IT Internship Program which will give you the opportunity to work within the Ryanair Labs Teams. After successful completion there will be a possibility of extending the cooperation on fixed-term civil contract / contract of employment and then prospect of staying with us long term!

We are looking for people available to attend our office for 40 hours per week – 8 hours daily from Monday to Friday (regular business hours starting between 8:00–9:30).

We are seeking individuals who have a story to tell and who have strong outside interests. Cultural fit at Ryanair is just as important as academics.

We are currently looking for talents in the field of Manual Software Testing. You will be paired up with our Senior QA Engineers who help your career take off! You will be working across our web or mobile projects, internal and dedicated to our customers.

The Role



- Learn and apply QA methodologies, tools, and testing frameworks.
- Partner up with the QA team in verifying software quality through manual testing activities.
- Execute test cases and accurately report defects, errors, or unexpected results.
- Assist in creating, maintaining, or updating test documentation.
- Collaborate with agile team members: testers, developers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
- Attend Agile (Scrum or Kanban) meetings – contribute as appropriate.
- Student / absolvent in a field of Computer Science or any IT background
- Good command of English (min. B2)
- Basic knowledge of manual software testing
- Hands-on experience with leading QA technologies.
- Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.
- Opportunity to work on meaningful projects that impact the organization.
- A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
- Potential for future career opportunities within the company.

Recruitment process



- Application form – send us your application in English plus short introduction of yourself, and why you want to join the IT Internship Program.
- Short test – we will send you a quick test to check your technical skills, but also creative thinking, time management and reading comprehension.
- Phone call – short conversation with Recruiter when we will share with you all the details about work and we will speak about your expectations and future. Also we will check your English level.
- Interview – technical interview with the Team and then Team Manager.
- Offer – if we’re a match, we’ll present you with an offer and schedule your start day with us!

During each of above steps we’ll be happy to answer any questions you may have. Apply today to discuss the role in more detail!

title: Operations Engineer Intern (Field)
text:
Description

Job Summary

This job can be based in: KTW1, KTW4 or WRO6

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

Key job responsibilities

Key Job Responsibilities

An engineering internship in Amazon will provide you with an unforgettable experience in a dynamic and international environment. Our internships serve to be an educational experience, where you will put your skills and bias for action to the test, to complete a project that will support your own learning in the engineering field.

The engineering team in Amazon maintain and optimize all technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network ranging from large, modern, purpose-built warehouses utilizing robotics and high-volume conveyance all the way through the value chain to small, high speed, delivery stations placed as close to our customers as possible.

We provide professional growth, opportunities to solve for complex engineering challenges, Material Handling Equipment, and opportunities to build your skills working with various teams and stakeholders. Our Operations Engineering Interns must be comfortable interfacing with and driving various functional teams and all stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

As an Engineering intern, you could have the opportunity to join one of the following teams: Project Management, Change Management, People Management, Planning, Contracting Management, Infrastructure, Reliability Maintenance and more. You will work on a project with real impact within Amazon. This could include:



-  Design, build, improve, and innovate order fulfilment infrastructure throughout the large-scale supply chain network.
-  Manage, design, and implement small to medium scope integrated automation projects with system elements such as high-speed sortation, multiple conveyors, package lines, and/or robotic work cells.
-  Working on a program to train technicians in the basics of control systems fault finding in order to raise the level of knowledge within the site.
-  Support within the EU Controls network on a project to enhance the capability to monitor MHE metrics and provide visualization and data to internal customers.
-  Develop alongside global teams to support the installation and commission of new equipment, including project managing implementation of new processes
-  Potential relocation to the designated work location.

A day in the life

A Day in the Life

Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of operations, either from a corporate perspective or from our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

The team works across industries, including consumer goods, and combines engineering depth with hands-on problem solving to help clients improve product performance, cost, and value.

You will act as a knowledge consultant in product development–related projects, helping teams identify practical product and cost improvement opportunities. You will work on Design-to-Value and target costing projects, support product teardown and redesign activities in our laboratories, and help translate technical insights into actions our clients can implement.

A core part of your role will be bringing an end-to-end engineering view of the product value stream from goods to production through packaging processes. You will analyze how products are designed, manufactured, and packaged, and help identify opportunities to improve cost, quality, manufacturability, and customer value. You will also contribute to product cost modeling, competitive benchmarking, and technical analysis across a range of consumer categories and materials.

You will work closely with colleagues across McKinsey’s global network and contribute to the firm’s knowledge base in product development, value engineering, and cost optimization. Along the way, you will receive exceptional training, apprenticeship, coaching, and mentoring.

There is a flexibility to hire at junior or analyst level, depending on your experience.

title: Electrical Components Specialist
text:
Job Description

Take innovation from idea to implementation.

At Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come, join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

All about the role:

We are looking for an Electrical Components Engineer with a strong electrical background to join an international product development environment, working closely with global suppliers and cross-functional teams.

In this role, you will act as the technical lead for selected electronic components, taking ownership of their development and coordinating activities across stakeholders.

You will contribute to the design and development of electromechanical components for household appliances (washing machines, tumble dryers, dishwashers), supporting all phases from design to validation and industrialization, in line with company standards.

Working closely with suppliers, factories, and internal teams, you will analyze and define technical solutions, operating with autonomy and sound judgment across a range of challenges.

This role is ideal for a results-driven engineer who thrives in a collaborative, international, and continuous improvement–oriented environment.

In detail, you will:



- Design and development of Electrical & Electro-Mechanical components for care products 
- Support cost reduction and quality improvement projects of electrical & electro-mechanical components 
- Support urgency cases testing for electrical parts e.g., part shortage, discontinued part 
- Project team member, responsible for electrical components development 
- Create engineering drawings of electrical components 
- Ensure electrical safety and conformity testing according National and International standards (IEC, CE, UL, etc.) 
- Conduct functional and reliability tests according Electrolux test specifications and procedures 
- Supplier development and technical support 
- Cost reduction projects for electrical and electro-mechanical components 
- Quality improvement projects for electrical and electro-mechanical components 

Who you are:



- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field 
- Previous experience in a similar role is an advantage, but we also welcome applications from early-career professionals with strong potential and a willingness to learn. 
- Solid knowledge of the design and development of electrical components for household appliances or consumer electronics
- Familiarity with national and international safety and testing standards 
- Experience with CAD tools (e.g., CATIA, NX) 
- Understanding of testing procedures, including environmental, EMC/EMI, performance, and safety testing 
- Good communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly 
- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills in cross-functional environments 
- Good proficiency in English, both written and spoken 

Where you'll be:

You will be based in our Żarów factory, Poland and report to the Electrical Components and Motor Control Manager.

Benefits highlights: 



-  Flexible work hours / hybrid work environment   
- Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services   
- Family-friendly benefits   
- Insurance policy plan   

We look forward to receiving your application!

Please submit your CV in English.

As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you

Find more on:

Electrolux Group

text:
Description

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Skills

As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:



-  Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
-  Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
-  Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst Intern to join our PPNR Stress Testing team. You will work alongside experienced quantitative analysts and gain hands-on experience in developing and applying models used to understand how financial businesses may perform under different economic scenarios.

In this role, you will:



-  Develop and enhance quantitative projection models using time-series data, regression techniques and other statistical and econometric approaches.

title: Information Security Engineer – Senior Penetration Tester
text:
Ryanair Labs are currently recruiting for an Information Security Engineer – Senior Penetration Tester to join Europe’s Largest Airline Group!

This is a very exciting time to join Ryanair as we look to expand our operation to 800 aircraft and 300 million guests within the next 10 years.

Ryanair Labs is the technology brand of Ryanair. Labs is a state of-the-art digital & IT innovation hub creating Europe’s Leading Travel Experience for our customers.

About The Role

A hands-on, individual-contributor role in a lean airline security team. You find exploitable weaknesses before attackers do across web and mobile applications, APIs, internal networks, identity and multicloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) including the AI-enabled systems we build and buy. You don’t stop at the report: you prove impact, drive fixes with owners, re-test, and turn what you learn into detection and hardening requirements.

How you’ll work: scope → test → prove → fix → verify



- Scope. Maintain an attack-surface inventory (external, internal, cloud, SaaS, AI systems); threat-model with owners; define rules of engagement and safety constraints, especially around operational systems.
- Test. Manual-first testing following recognised methodologies (OWASP WSTG/ASVS/MASVS, PTES, MITRE ATT&CK), with automation for breadth.
- Prove. Demonstrate real impact with safe proof-of-concept exploits and attack chains; rate with CVSS plus business context. Scanner output is not a finding.
- Fix. Write remediation owners can act on; pair with engineers; convert findings into detection requirements and control improvements for the detection team.
- Verify. Re-test, track closure, measure time-to-remediate and recurrence.

What You’ll Do



- Test passenger-facing and internal web, mobile and API applications.
- Test internal/external networks, Active Directory / Entra ID and identity attack paths.
- Cloud penetration testing across AWS, GCP and Azure: IAM privilege escalation, misconfigurations, exposed services, CI/CD and secrets.
- AI/LLM application testing: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agency and tool abuse, RAG data leakage and poisoning, agent/MCP integration weaknesses mapped to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.
- Run adversary emulation and purple-team exercises with detection engineering.
- Build and maintain tooling and automation; use LLM assistants and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, OpenCode) for recon automation, PoC development, output parsing and report drafting, validating results and respecting data-handling boundaries.
- Write clear reports and executive summaries; present findings to engineers and leadership.

Must have



- 4+ years hands-on penetration testing / offensive security.
- Strong web/API and network/AD testing with manual exploitation, not just scanning.
- Cloud pentesting in at least two of AWS, GCP, Azure, including IAM and identity attack paths.
- Scripting in Python (plus Bash/PowerShell); comfortable reading, modifying and writing exploits and tooling.
- Practical use of MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP methodologies; CVSS and risk-based reporting.
- AI skillset: effective daily use of LLM assistants and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode) with critical validation of output; working knowledge of how LLM applications, RAG pipelines and agents are built and where they break (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS); ability to design and run structured tests against AI systems.
- Safe testing discipline in production and safety-critical environments; strict rules of engagement.
- Clear written and verbal communication to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have



- Strongly valued: contributions to, or research on, AI red-teaming agents building or extending LLM-driven offensive tooling (autonomous recon, exploitation or prompt-injection agents), automated jailbreak and injection evaluation harnesses, or benchmarks for AI security testing. Ope

text:

In our HVDC Protection Team, we are testing and verifying the hardware and software for our innovative HVDC Projects in our Test Center and ensure proper functionality and good quality of our HVDC Plants worldwide during commissioning. Our diverse and multinational teams are working closely together with project management, engineering as well as with end customers to provide customized solutions based on the latest innovations in HVDC technology.

- You actively advance the Energy Transition by bringing our HVDC projects to a successful completion with our customers
- You are part of a project team in Integration Testing and you carry out Functional Tests of the Control & Protection hardware and software in one of our test centers
- You independently trace bugs and support our Software Engineering in debugging
- You are responsible for the execution and documentation of the Functional Performance Tests (FPT) and Dynamic Performance Tests (DPT) of the HVDC System, including Customer Acceptance Tests in one of our test centers
- You are responsible for the commissioning of the Measuring System, the DC Protection System and the Transient Fault Recorder for our HVDC Projects as a part of a highly motivated team, at our customers sites worldwide 
- You support our Commissioning Management in Quality, Risk and Claim Management and you actively participate in our improvement programs


What You Bring



- Completed degree in electrical engineering, energy technology or comparable education / qualification

- Knowledge or ideally working experience in the field of Electrical Engineering and Commissioning of Electrical Power Stations or HVDC Systems

- Fluent English language skills, additional languages are a plus

title: QA Software Engineering Expert
text:
Jako tester w naszym zespole transformacyjnym stawisz czoła wyzwaniu nowej generacji: weryfikacji systemów, w których kod współtworzony jest przez agentic AI. Twoim głównym celem będzie dbanie o to, by nowoczesne aplikacje CRM/ERP były nie tylko w pełni funkcjonalne, ale wolne od błędów. W modelu zwinnych, 2-3 osobowych zespołów (taxi-teams) staniesz się kluczowym ogniwem łączącym wizję analityka biznesowego z wygenerowaną rzeczywistością kodu. To rola dla eksperta, który chce redefiniować standardy QA w erze AI.

Profil stanowiska



- Posiadasz min. 5 letnie doświadczenie w testowaniu złożonych aplikacji biznesowych (mile widziane systemy klasy ERP/CRM).
- Posiadasz zaawansowane umiejętności w zakresie tworzenia testów automatycznych (E2E, API).
- Znasz i potrafisz efektywnie wykorzystywać narzędzia do testowania wydajnościowego, co jest kluczowe przy dużej liczbie użytkowników systemów ERP.
- Cechujesz się wybitnie krytycznym myśleniem - potrafisz bezbłędnie "złapać" anomalie i błędy logiczne, które AI mogło ukryć pod pozorem poprawnie wyglądającego kodu.

Twoje zadania



- Automatyzacja testów wspomagana przez AI: Efektywne wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do błyskawicznego generowania zaawansowanych scenariuszy testowych oraz skryptów (np. Playwright, Cypress).
- Weryfikacja zgodności z systemami ERP/CRM: Skrupulatne sprawdzanie, czy nowo powstająca aplikacja webowa zwraca identyczne i poprawne wyniki biznesowe co system źródłowy oparty na kodzie legacy.
- Testy regresji i integracji: Zapewnienie najwyższej stabilności całego ekosystemu w warunkach dynamicznego tempa dostarczania nowych funkcji przez zespoły typu taxi-teams.
- Audyt UX/UI: Bliska współpraca z Product Designerem w celu weryfikacji, czy frontend wygenerowany przez AI jest w 100% zgodny z przyjętym Design Systemem.

Dla Ciebie



- Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych.
- System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy.
- Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura).
- Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace.
- Współpraca z różnymi zespołami kompetencyjnymi, która pozwoli Ci na poznanie nowych technologii i poszerzenie wiedzy w obszarze IT.
- Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy, realny wpływ na podejmowane decyzje biznesowe.
- Udogodnienia dla rowerzystów/ rowerzystek (stojaki, szatnie, rowerownie, stacja naprawcza), a dla tych, co do pracy docierają samochodem – naziemny i podziemny parking.

title: Senior Automation Engineer – Siemens PCS 7 / Process Safety
text:
Wrocław / projekty w Polsce i za granicą
 
Szukamy doświadczonego inżyniera z bardzo dobrą praktyczną znajomością Siemens SIMATIC PCS7, zainteresowanego realizacją wymagających projektów automatyki przemysłowej w sektorach energetycznym i Oil & Gas, w tym pracami offshore.
Zależy nam na ekspercie, który potrafi kompleksowo analizować systemy sterowania, samodzielnie podejmować decyzje techniczne i rozwiązywać złożone problemy, a jednocześnie chce mieć realny wpływ na rozwój kompetencji inżynierskich ISCAS.
 
Kim jesteśmy
ISCAS od ponad 13 lat realizuje projekty z zakresu automatyki przemysłowej, systemów sterowania i oprogramowania dla przemysłu.
Specjalizujemy się w rozwiązaniach opartych na Siemens SIMATIC PCS7, realizując projekty m.in. dla energetyki oraz sektora Oil & Gas, w tym obejmujące prace offshore.
Rozwijamy kompetencje w obszarze PCS 7 i Process Safety, zwiększając jednocześnie zakres odpowiedzialności technicznej za realizowane projekty, od engineeringu i integracji systemów po IAT/FAT/SAT i commissioning.
 
Kogo szukamy
Szukamy osoby z bardzo dobrą praktyczną znajomością systemów DCS SIMATIC PCS7.
 
Szczególnie interesuje nas doświadczenie w obszarach:

- Projektowanie i programowanie systemów SIMATIC PCS 7, w tym konfiguracja AS / ES / OS Server / OS Client.

- Znajomość architektury systemów PCS 7, w tym systemów redundantnych.
- Znajomość komunikacji przemysłowej, w szczególności PROFIBUS, PROFINET i Industrial Ethernet.

- Testowanie i uruchamianie systemów automatyki, w tym FAT / SAT.
- Analiza procesów technologicznych i przekładanie wymagań procesowych na rozwiązania systemów sterowania.
- Doświadczenie w SIMATIC PCS 7 Process Safety, w szczególności F-Systems lub Safety Matrix.
 
Dodatkowym atutem będzie doświadczenie w:

- Symulacji i wirtualizacji systemów sterowania, w tym Siemens SIMIT.
- Projektach dla energetyki i Oil & Gas, w tym offshore.
- Projektowaniu i walidacji funkcji bezpieczeństwa zgodnie z IEC 61508 / IEC 61511 (SIL).
- Prowadzeniu technicznym projektów i podejmowaniu decyzji architektonicznych.
- Mentoringu inżynierów oraz rozwijaniu standardów i bibliotek technicznych.
- Innych platformach DCS, w szczególności ABB System 800xA oraz Honeywell Experion PKS.
 
Co będziesz robić
W zależności od doświadczenia i kompetencji będziesz:

- Projektować, programować i wdrażać rozwiązania automatyki przemysłowej oparte na Siemens PCS7.
- Analizować architekturę systemów sterowania i proponować rozwiązania techniczne.
- Uczestniczyć w projektach modernizacji i migracji systemów DCS
- Przygotowywać i weryfikować rozwiązania techniczne dla klientów.
- Realizować FAT, SAT i uruchomieniach instalacji przemysłowych.
- Diagnozować i rozwiązywać złożone problemy techniczne.
- Wspierać rozwój kompetencji zespołu oraz standardów i bibliotek inżynierskich ISCAS.


 
Dlatego osoba, która do nas dołączy, będzie miała realny wpływ na:

- Rozwiązania techniczne i sposób realizacji projektów.
- Decyzje techniczne i architektoniczne w realizowanych projektach.
- Rozwój kompetencji zespołu, standardów i dobrych praktyk inżynierskich.

To stanowisko dla kogoś, kto chce nie tylko realizować wymagające projekty, ale również mieć realny wpływ na rozwiązania techniczne i kierunek rozwoju kompetencji inżynierskich ISCAS.

title: Control Logic and PLC Debugger
text:
We are looking for a 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹 𝗟𝗼𝗴𝗶𝗰 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗣𝗟𝗖 𝗗𝗲𝗯𝘂𝗴𝗴𝗲𝗿. You'll build control logic debugging tasks around an automated machine, line or process cell you have worked on, so a leading AI company can measure how well models handle real embedded engineering problems.


𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘀:

- Location: Poland
- Working model: Hybrid
- Start date: ASAP
- Employment type: Freelance – hourly rate: $70–90 (paid per accepted task)


𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:

- Build a benchmark environment around an automated machine, line or process cell you have worked on
- Include the PLC program in ladder, structured text or function blocks (IEC 61131-3 or similar), the I/O map, device and drive datasheets, the sequence and interlock specification, alarm and event logs, and a simulator or test harness for the process
- Set up the tools the work needs – an IEC 61131-3 runtime or compiler such as OpenPLC or MATIEC, the process simulator, Python, PDF tools
- Write five or more tasks, each built on a sequence, interlock or recipe fault on that cell (e.g. a sequence that stalls when one sensor responds late, an interlock that can be bypassed on restart, a recipe change that breaks a dosing step)
- Frame each task so the model must work through the program and logs, change the logic, run it against the simulator, and deliver the patched program plus answer.json naming the change
- Write a hidden marking script that runs the patched program through the normal sequence and hidden fault scenarios – a late sensor, a drive trip, power loss mid-cycle, an operator restart – scoring 0.0 to 1.0 by the share that end in a safe and correct state
- Design tasks where the naive fix passes the normal sequence but fails a fault path
- Supply your own answer (scoring 1.0) and a naive answer a competent engineer might give first (scoring below 0.3)


𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀:

- Hands-on controls engineering experience on an automated machine, line or process cell
- Strong PLC programming skills in ladder, structured text or function blocks (IEC 61131-3 or similar)
- Experience designing and debugging sequences, interlocks and recipes
- Able to work from I/O maps, device and drive datasheets, and sequence and interlock specifications
- Experience diagnosing faults from alarm and event logs
- Comfortable with IEC 61131-3 runtimes or compilers such as OpenPLC or MATIEC, and process simulators or test harnesses
- Python skills to write automated marking scripts

O firmie Carrier 

Carrier Global Corporation, światowy lider w dziedzinie inteligentnych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, angażuje się w tworzenie innowacji, które zapewniają komfort, bezpieczeństwo i zrównoważony rozwój. Dzięki nowoczesnym rozwiązaniom w zakresie kontroli temperatury, jakości powietrza oraz transportu poprawiamy jakość życia, wspieramy kluczowe sektory gospodarki oraz zapewniamy bezpieczny transport żywności, leków ratujących życie i wielu innych produktów. title: Senior Animation Programmer
text:
Techland is one of the biggest video game companies in Poland, with over 30 years of experience in the gaming industry. From our studios in Wroclaw and Warsaw, we’ve built an international team of more than 500 talented professionals, all dedicated to pushing the boundaries of game development.



We’re known for creating iconic franchises like Call of Juarez and the zombie genre-defining Dying Light, which has been played by over 45 million players worldwide. title: С & C++ Embedded Engineer
text:
Team Summary

Our embedded software engineering team's mission is to craft reliable, high-performance solutions that reach millions of homes worldwide within the home security market. We follow agile development methodologies with regular sprint cycles, code reviews, and continuous integration practices. The team's established approach emphasizes comprehensive testing, rigorous security standards, and close collaboration with hardware engineering, product management, and customer support teams. We pride ourselves on writing clean, maintainable code and fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

Job Summary

We're seeking a skilled C & C++ Embedded Engineer to take ownership of critical software components in our camera-based security devices. This role involves maintaining existing products through comprehensive debugging and bug fixing, as well as developing innovative new features.

Responsibilities and Duties



- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality embedded software in C and C++ for camera-based security devices.
- Debug and resolve complex software, hardware, and network connectivity issues across the entire software stack.
- Develop new features and improve existing codebases for the product line.
- Optimize software performance for resource-constrained embedded environments.
- Conduct code reviews and provide technical mentorship to team members.
- Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision-making processes.
- Collaborate with QA teams to develop comprehensive testing strategies.
- Document software designs, APIs, libraries, and troubleshooting procedures.

Qualifications And Skills



- At least 5+ years of commercial experience in embedded development, with expertise in C and C++ (C++17 standard) and deep knowledge of RTOS and microcontroller architectures (ARM, RISC-V).
- Proficiency in the full SDLC, including professional engineering practices like Git, CMake, code reviews, and continuous integration.
- Solid understanding of network programming and experience with multithreading on multicore microcontrollers.
- Expertise in communication interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, and Wi-Fi) and experience writing device drivers and libraries.
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex projects.
- Excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation, with a collaborative mindset for cross-functional team environments.
- At least an Upper-Intermediate level in both written and spoken English (B2).
- Hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting and debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, etc.) and cross-compilation tool chains.

Nice to have



- Understanding of security protocols and encryption methods
- Experience with Python for scripting and automation
- Experience using AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and code quality

We offer multiple benefits that include



- The environment of equal opportunities, transparent and value-based corporate culture, and an individual approach to each team member
- Competitive salary packages with performance-based annual reviews.
- Opportunity to receive a Performance Bonus for your individual achievements and a Loyalty Bonus recognizing your dedication to the company.
- Employment via Contract of Employment (UoP) in complete alignment with Polish Labour Law.
- Guaranteed paid vacation, public holidays, and medical leaves as per statutory regulations.
- Continuous growth and development opportunities through internal knowledge hubs, corporate courses, and free English classes
- Comprehensive private medical insurance to supplement your standard NFZ coverage.

Dołącz do naszego międzynarodowego i przyjaznego zespołu, i sam przekonaj się, dlaczego warto być częścią UPM. Dołącz do Zespołu Lidera Branży – Czekamy na Ciebie w UPM Adhesive Materials!” – Radosław, Mill Services Technicians' Team Leader

Co będziesz robić



- Usuwać awarię zgodnie z priorytetami oraz wdrażać działania korygujące
- Wykonywać prace konserwacyjne i przeglądy
- Wykonywać modernizacje oraz usprawnienia
- Przestrzegać instrukcji, zasad i standardów firmy

Harmonogram pracy: praca w systemie równoważnym po 12 godzin

Kim jesteś



- Posiadasz wykształcenie kierunkowe np. automatyka, elektronika, mechatronika
- Posiadasz doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku oraz znajomość sterowania Siemens S7 oraz ABB
- Potrafisz czytać dokumentację techniczną schematów sterowania elektrycznego i projektowania prostych układów sterowania automatyki
- Znasz podstawy instalacji pneumatycznych oraz hydraulicznych
- Posiadasz uprawnienia SEP E1/E2/E3 (mile widziane)
- Posługujesz się językiem polskim w stopniu umożliwiającym czytanie i rozumienie instrukcji i procedur

Zakres wynagrodzenia/płace: pensja na start już od 8000 zł brutto miesięcznie

Co oferujemy



- Atrakcyjne warunki finansowe i stabilne zatrudnienie: wynagrodzenie od 8000 zł brutto na start (zależne od doświadczenia), premie, dodatek do 1000 zł brutto za system 4‑brygadowy, 100% płatne nadgodziny oraz umowa o pracę bezpośrednio w UPM.
- Rozbudowany pakiet benefitów: domowe obiady za 2 zł, dofinansowanie karty Multisport, prywatna opieka medyczna dla Ciebie i rodziny oraz ubezpieczenie grupowe NNW.
- Bezpieczeństwo i dobra atmosfera pracy: Dbamy o siebie nawzajem i o dobre relacje w zespołach. Priorytetowo traktujemy bezpieczeństwo naszych pracowników, zapewniając wszystkim bezpieczny powrót do domu.
- Dobra praca: Z zaangażowaniem wykonujemy swoją pracę, wytwarzając wysokiej jakości, zrównoważone rozwiązania etykietowe dla naszych klientów na całym świecie. Jesteśmy zgranym i zaangażowanym zespołem.
- Możliwości rozwoju: Oferujemy szerokie możliwości nauki i rozwoju kariery.
- Troska o ludzi i środowisko: Odpowiedzialność leży u podstaw wszystkiego, co robimy. Stawiamy sobie ambitne cele związane ze zrównoważonym rozwojem i stale podnosimy poprzeczkę. Wspólnie tworzymy naszą codzienną rzeczywistość – z myślą o przyszłości wolnej od paliw kopalnych!

title: Specjalista ds. Technologii Autonomicznych w Górnictwie
text:
O firmie
Dla naszego Klienta, międzynarodowej organizacji rozwijającej nowoczesne rozwiązania dla przemysłu wydobywczego, poszukujemy osoby, która będzie uczestniczyć we wdrażaniu i rozwijaniu autonomicznych systemów wykorzystywanych w kopalniach i kamieniołomach. Stanowisko łączy prowadzenie projektów technologicznych, wsparcie aplikacyjne oraz współpracę z zespołami operacyjnymi na całym świecie.


Obowiązki

- prowadzenie międzynarodowych wdrożeń systemów autonomicznych dla ciężkiego sprzętu mobilnego, m.in. wozideł, koparek, ładowarek i spycharek,
- koordynowanie instalacji, testów, odbiorów i uruchomień technologii,
- przygotowywanie harmonogramów, analiz biznesowych i planów wdrożeniowych,
- monitorowanie działania systemów oraz kluczowych wskaźników efektywności,
- diagnozowanie problemów, obsługa incydentów i współpraca z dostawcami technologii oraz zespołami IT/OT,
- wspieranie integracji aplikacji autonomicznych z systemami zarządzania flotą i procesami operacyjnymi,
- optymalizacja wykorzystania floty, przepływu materiałów i dostępności systemów,
- tworzenie dokumentacji, instrukcji oraz materiałów dla użytkowników,
- prowadzenie warsztatów i szkoleń wspierających wdrażanie nowych technologii.


Wymagane umiejętności:

- minimum 2 lata doświadczenia w zarządzaniu projektami, consultingu, wdrażaniu technologii, operacjach wydobywczych lub pracy z flotą ciężkich maszyn,
- wykształcenie wyższe w obszarze inżynierii, informatyki, biznesu lub pokrewnym,
- zainteresowanie technologiami autonomicznymi, automatyką lub systemami sterowania,
- umiejętność analizowania danych operacyjnych i rozwiązywania problemów technicznych,
- znajomość metod i narzędzi zarządzania projektami,
- rozwinięte umiejętności komunikacyjne oraz gotowość do pracy w środowisku międzynarodowym,
- samodzielność, elastyczność i nastawienie na poszukiwanie rozwiązań.


Preferowane umiejętności

- znajomość branży wydobywczej lub ciężkiego sprzętu mobilnego,
- doświadczenie w integracji IT/OT, testach UAT albo uruchamianiu systemów,
- znajomość systemów zarządzania flotą lub oprogramowania przemysłowego,
- doświadczenie we wsparciu aplikacyjnym, zarządzaniu incydentami lub współpracy z dostawcami technologii.


Oferujemy

- udział w międzynarodowych projektach związanych z autonomizacją procesów wydobywczych,
- pracę z nowoczesnymi technologiami, systemami IT/OT i rozwiązaniami do zarządzania flotą,
- realny wpływ na wdrażanie i rozwój innowacyjnych rozwiązań przemysłowych,
- współpracę z globalnymi zespołami operacyjnymi i technologicznymi,
- stanowisko łączące technologię, zarządzanie projektami oraz analizę danych.

title: Mechatronik/Mechatroniczka
text:
Org Marketing Statement

Parker Hannifin EMEA Sarl (PHEMEA), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for Parker in the EMEA region. It is supported by a network of Parker Manufacturing Divisions and Sales Company Entities. The Fluid Connectors Group Europe is a strategic business Group within PHEMEA. High Pressure Connectors Europe is a key service provider to the Fluid Connectors Group Europe

Parker Hannifin Manufacturing High Pressure Connectors Europe (HPCE) rozpoczęło swoją działalność w 1995 roku we Wrocławiu, a od 2004 roku mieści się w Siechnicach. Produkuje m.in. złączki hydrauliczne, zawory, przyłącza pomiarowe (EMA), szybkozłączki (UPTC). Nasze produkty wykorzystywane są w układach hydraulicznych maszyn i pojazdów roboczych, np. ładowarkach, dźwigach.Obecnie zatrudnia około 280 pracowników, m.in. w działach: jakości, inżynierii, logistyki, planowania, HR, kontrollingu, utrzymania ruchu oraz w obszarze produkcji.

Pracownik/pracowniczka na stanowisku Mechatronika/Mechatroniczki raportuje bezpośrednio do Mistrza Utrzymania Ruchu, a do jego/jej obowiązków należą:



- Opracowanie i realizacja przeglądów prewencyjnych maszyn mających na celu zapewnienie ciągłości produkcji
- Wykonywanie bieżących napraw / usuwanie awarii z maszyn - głównie CNC
- Uczestnictwo przy modyfikacjach i uruchamianiu nowych projektów inwestycyjnych maszyn i urządzeń
- Wykonywanie modernizacji maszyn i urządzeń
- Nanoszenie zmian w dokumentacji technicznej
- Współpraca z zewnętrznymi serwisami i firmami usługowymi
- Dbanie o czystość i porządek zgodnie z zasadami 5S
- Przekazywanie obsłudze maszyn wiedzy technicznej na temat maszyn
- Ciągłe podnoszenie wiedzy na temat budowy i elementów systemów sterowania.

Od Kandydatów/kandydatek Oczekujemy



- 3 lata doświadczenia w pracy na podobnym stanowisku w firmie o profilu przemysłowym
- Wykształcenia zawodowego lub technicznego w kierunku elektronika, automatyka, mechatronika lub pokrewne
- Znajomości zagadnień z zakresu elektryki
- Znajomości podstawowej obsługi maszyn konwencjonalnych i CNC 
- Znajomości budowy i zasad działania maszyn konwencjonalnych i CNC
- Świadectwa kwalifikacji E1 do 1KV w zakresie obsługi, konserwacji, remontów, montażu
- Chęci rozwoju i podnoszenia kwalifikacji

Mile Widziane



- Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego (w tym słownictwo techniczne)
- Znajomość wymagań norm ISO 9001 i ISO 14001
- Znajomość wymagań minimalnych i zasadniczych dla maszyn i urządzeń technicznych

Oferujemy



- Stałe zatrudnienie (umowa o pracę) w stabilnej międzynarodowej firmie
- Pracę w systemie zmianowym
- Możliwość rozwoju zawodowego
- Pakiet opieki medycznej
- Możliwość dołączenia do ubezpieczenia grupowego
- Dofinansowane posiłki w kantynie pracowniczej
- Szereg benefitów, w tym m.in.: program emerytalny, dofinansowanie do zajęć językowych, kawa, herbata gratis, bony świąteczne, Multisport.

Parker jest pracodawcą zapewniającym równe szanse i nie dyskryminuje ze względu na wiek, rasę, religię, pochodzenie etniczne, płeć, orientację seksualną lub niepełnosprawność

Firma Parker jest zobowiązana do przestrzegania wszystkich obowiązujących przepisów ustawowych i wykonawczych dotyczących gromadzenia, wykorzystywania, przekazywania i przechowywania danych osobowych, w tym prawa Stanów Zjednoczonych, Unii Europejskiej (w tym rozporządzenia UE 2016/679 zwanego „Ogólnym Rozporządzeniem o Ochronie Danych ”) oraz innych krajów, w których firma Parker prowadzi swoją działalność.

text:

title: Automatyk zmianowy/ Automatyczka zmianowa
text:
Overview

Produkty PepsiCo wywołują radość konsumentów ponad miliard razy dziennie w 200 państwach i terytoriach na całym świecie. Przychód netto PepsiCo w 2021 wyniósł ponad 79 miliardów dolarów (około 351 miliardów złotych), dzięki uzupełniającemu się portfolio napojów i żywności przetworzonej, jak Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker i SodaStream. PepsiCo oferuje szeroką gamę produktów, włączając w to wiele kultowych marek, z których każda generuje ponad miliardowy dochód ze sprzedaży w ciągu roku.

Kierujemy się naszą wizją bycia światowym liderem napojów i przetworzonej żywości dzięki wygrywaniu z PepsiCo Positive (pep+). pep+ to nasza strategiczna całościowa transformacja, która w centrum stawia zrównoważony rozwój i kapitał ludzki. Chcemy wzrastać operując w ramach granic naszej planety i inspirując pozytywne zmiany dla ziemi i ludzi. By dowiedzieć się więcej, odwiedź www.pepsico.com.

W celu zapewnienia świadomych i przejrzystych negocjacji, osoby zaproszone na rozmowę kwalifikacyjną, otrzymają informacje dotyczące początkowego poziomu wynagrodzenia na danym stanowisku. Podczas rozmowy odpowiemy na postawione pytania oraz przekażemy dodatkowe informacje dotyczące procesu. Oczekiwany początkowy zakres wynagrodzenia dla tego stanowiska wynosi 93900 PLN rocznie. Lokalizacja, potwierdzone umiejętności, doświadczenie oraz wykształcenie będą brane pod uwagę przy ustalaniu rzeczywistego wynagrodzenia.

Responsibilities



- diagnostyka, naprawa i rozbudowa układów elektrycznych, pneumatyki i systemów sterowania z PLC oraz systemów wizyjnych
- analiza programów PLC pod kątem diagnostyki złożonych problemów
- analiza przyczyn awarii oraz podejmowanie działań prewencyjnych w celu ich eliminacji
- dokonywanie pomiarów, przeglądów, napraw, konserwacji maszyn i urządzeń
- reagowanie na zgłoszenia i awarie w celu utrzymania ciągłości pracy zakładu
- precyzyjne raportowanie problemów i podjętych działań
- wdrażanie działań zmierzających do optymalizacji prac w ramach samodzielnych projektów

Qualifications



- wykształcenie minimum średnie w zakresie: automatyka, elektronika, mechatronika lub elektryka
- minimum dwuletnie doświadczenie zawodowe z obszaru automatyki, elektrotechniki lub elektroniki przemysłowej
- posiadanie uprawnień SEP do 1kV
- znajomość podstawowych układów elektrycznych, pneumatyki i systemów sterowania z PLC oraz metod ich diagnostyki

title: Power Tool Center Engineer (f/m/d) - automotive
text:
Find more than just a job – find your peace of mind! All around the globe customers rely on our safe connecting solutions. But we are also a reliable partner for our employees. About 2,000 colleagues in more than 30 countries play their part in ensuring that our products are the trusted solution for mission-critical applications. Whether it’s engines, airbags, or heart pumps – every day we develop connecting solutions for a wide variety of industries and thus take important steps towards a better future. Would you like to be a part of it? 


Our production plant in Poland, opened in 2018, supplies millions of high-end clamps, rings and ‘Quick Connectors’ solutions to customers in the vehicle and manufacturing industries. Our team is responsible for the V-Clamps and Straps product groups. These are used mostly for exhaust systems and tank fixation systems in the vehicle powertrain. Strengthen our team in Legnickie Pole (Legnica) at the earliest possible date!



Job Description


Responsible for service and customer support for Oetiker electronic and pneumatic tools, that are used with 

Oetiker clamps and rings, for customers in EMEA Region. 


 Programming e.g., Siemens Production System (SPS) and common configuration of industrial networks 

• Onsite customer installation of pneumatic and electronic tooling into high-end automated assembly lines 

• Provide customer training and support of Oetiker installation tools remotely or at customer location 

• Assembly of new power tools and tool repairs within PTC department or onsite at customer location 

• Analyze existing installation tools and make technical recommendations to improve overall performance 

• Up to 25% travel requirement within Europe 

• Ensure compliance with all applicable safety and environmental regulations 

• Compliance to the Management Manual, IATF 16949, ISO 9001 & ISO 14001 requirements 

• Coordination with cross functional teams (i.e. R&D, product marketing, logistics and sales)



Qualifications


• Extensive knowledge of Serial and Ethernet/IP Protocols for industrial equipment 

• Extensive knowledge of PLC’s to interact with automated equipment 

• Excellent written & verbal native language skills 

• Proficient Computer skills (Microsoft Office, Excel, Power Point) 

• Ability to understand electrical/electronic schematics 

• Create and maintain electrical/electronic schematics 

• Ability to trouble shoot electrical/electronic problems (i.e. Multimeter, stripping wires) 

• Able to provide detail troubleshooting explanations (why and how something was fixed) 

• Soft Skills - Customer Service mindset, self-starter, willingness to learn, team player 

• You have good spoken and written English language skills. 

• Project Management (good to have, not mandatory) 

• CAD modeling and basic knowledge of SAP (good to have, not mandatory) 



Additional Information


WHAT YOU’LL GET



- A friendly working atmosphere
- Flexibility regarding working hours
- Systematic Onboarding Program tailored for your position
- Freedom for personal growth in a team with a unique culture
- Fair compensation and attractive benefits (e.g., every five years of service our employees can choose between half a salary and 10 days of additional vacation) 
Working together to make over 2 billion connections every year. That’s what we do at Oetiker. Our ‘OneOetiker’ culture is built on open and respectful collaboration and strong relationships with team members. Our strength comes directly from our team, our values and a culture of trust, teamwork, and professional growth.


We strongly encourage equal rights and gender equality. At Oetiker, everyone has the same possibilities to grow and develop with us.


Get to know us to get ahead.

text:

Jako firma z polskimi korzeniami, mamy pięć oddziałów w Polsce, z główną siedzibą w Krakowie, a także biuro w Monachium.

Nasza kultura organizacyjna opiera się na otwartości i budowaniu partnerskich relacji. Wierzymy, że sukces osiąga się przez współpracę i komunikację, co odzwierciedla się w naszym codziennym działaniu. Z dumą możemy powiedzieć, że Endego to miejsce, gdzie na pierwszym planie są ludzie.

Nasza załoga to obecnie 250 wykwalifikowanych specjalistów, zarówno inżynierów i inżynierek, jak i ekspertów i ekspertek w innych dziedzinach. Jesteśmy dynamicznie rozwijającą się firmą, a nasz zespół stale się powiększa.

Zostań częścią Endego i kształtuj z nami przyszłość inżynierii!

title: Control Algorithms Engineer
text:
Job Description

From ideas to reality. Decode the future.

At Electrolux Group, a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

About the role:

For more than one hundred years now, the Electrolux Group has been working at shaping living for the better, developing products that meet people’s demands in terms of taste, care and wellbeing. But as consumer needs and wants continue to evolve, we have even more work to do. It's our R&D teams that ensure our company stays at the forefront of innovation, investigating and making use of the latest technology in order to enable our company to keep delivering outstanding experiences.

What you’ll do:

We are looking for a Control Algorithms Engineer to join our R&D Product Line Dish organization. In this role, you will enhance product functionality through advanced control algorithms and AI-driven solutions, while developing and refining system models that serve as the foundation for simulations, virtual labs, and automated software testing.

In detail, you will:



-  Translate project or product requirements into control algorithm specifications.
-  Design and develop modular control algorithms using the Model-Based Design (MBD) framework.
-  Automatically generate production-ready source code (ACG) for firmware integration.
-  Validate algorithms through both simulations and physical (in-appliance) tests.
-  Evaluate algorithm performance against targets and ensure robustness and reliability.
-  Produce and maintain technical documentation (e.g., Algorithm Specifications, Calibration and Test Manuals).
-  Develop and maintain system models (digital twins) for Software-in-the-Loop (SiL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) applications using the MBD framework.
-  Calibrate model parameters, assess simulation performance and generate comprehensive model documentation.
-  Develop MATLAB and/or Python tools for data analysis from real and virtual testing environments.
-  Act as a technical reference for assigned activities, supporting development, testing, and implementation phases.
-  Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to achieve project objectives.

As part of the culture of continuous improvement, you will also be involved in Lean Thinking projects and activities (EMS/EAI).

Who you are:



- Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronic / Mechatronic / Automation Engineering,
- Physics, Mathematics, or similar technical fields
- Good knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink
- Good programming skills
- Good knowledge of signal processing and statistics
- Good understanding of dynamic systems and modelling
- Experience in data analysis and basic understanding of Machine Learning techniques
- Fluent English, both written and spoken

Where you’ll be:

You will be based at the Zarow Factory Plant, located in Poland. It will be necessary to be available for international travel two to four times a year. Benefits include:



- Flexible work hours/hybrid work environment;
- Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services;
- Family-friendly benefits such as extended paternity leave (4 weeks);
- Insurance policy plan;
- Extensive learning opportunities and flexible career path.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Please submit your CV in English.

As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you

Find more on:

Electrolux Group

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
text:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists 

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

What You Will Do



- Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself
- Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits
- Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten
- Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix
- Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit
- Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted

Who You Are



- You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you
- High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start
- Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts
- Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you
- Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully
- Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point

Your Toolbox

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.

What We Expect At This Level



- 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained
- Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here
- Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher

- Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one

title: Senior Software Engineer, On-Device Voice Reconstruction AI
text:
Senior Software Engineer, On-Device Voice AI
Remote · Full-time · ~30% travel


About Whispp
Whispp is an award-winning deep-tech startup in Leiden. Our on-device Voice Reconstruction AI turns whispered, affected, and noisy speech into a person's clear, natural voice — in under 100 ms, on-device, with full speaker identity preserved. We license the technology as an SDK to smartphone and PC OEMs, chipset vendors, and hearing-protection manufacturers, and we have active proof-of-concept programs with tier-1 partners.


The role
You are the technical bridge between our AI platform and the OEM partners who embed it. You own the hands-on work of getting our SDK running on customer hardware, from first scoping call through validated PoC, signed NRE, and production integration.
This is our first dedicated integration hire. You'll work directly with our AI researchers, full-stack engineer, Technical Product Manager, and business development team — and set the technical foundations that let us run multiple OEM programs at once.


What you'll do
Integration and delivery

- Integrate and validate the W2S SDK on customer devices, chipsets, and OS environments — Qualcomm Snapdragon, PC NPUs, emerging hearable platforms.
- Own technical execution of PoC and NRE programs: hardware setup, milestones, KPI measurement, demos, and final scope documentation.
- Find and fix integration blockers early — hardware quirks, OS audio pipeline incompatibilities, latency and performance gaps.
- Keep demo hardware reliable and ready for customer meetings and trade shows.
Customer engagement

- Act as the primary technical contact for OEM engineering teams during PoC, NRE, and validation.
- Translate customer constraints — microphone configurations, NPU limits, audio pipeline architecture — into concrete integration scopes.
- Back up the sales team with technical depth on scoping calls and in proposals.
Platform and tooling

- Improve SDK robustness and on-device execution across CPU and NPU targets.
- Build repeatable integration playbooks, test harnesses, and hardware setups that cut time-to-integration for each new OEM.
- Feed real-world findings — noise conditions, microphone behavior, latency, personalization edge cases — back to the AI team.
- Maintain integration documentation from v0.7 to v1.0 as the SDK and customer feedback evolve.


What we're looking for

- Strong C/C++ for embedded or mobile platform work.
- Android platform engineering in Kotlin/Java.
- Hands-on edge AI inference: NPU/DSP acceleration, TFLite, ONNX Runtime, or similar.
- Experience securing models on device — TEEs and secure enclaves on ARM and x86.
- Real-time audio processing, and solid grasp of Android audio pipelines (AudioReach, AudioRecord, AAudio, Oboe).
- SDK development or integration of third-party AI, audio, or DSP libraries into shipping products.
- AOSP experience is strong advantage.
- Windows audio frameworks (WASAPI, Windows Audio Session).
- 6+ years in embedded, mobile platform, or systems engineering.
- Proven ability to work directly with customer engineering teams and document outcomes clearly.
- Fluent written and spoken English; Dutch is a bonus.
- Willing to travel to customer sites around 30% of the time.


Nice to have

- Speech processing, voice AI, or audio enhancement background.
- Work with Qualcomm, MediaTek, or ARM.
- On-device model optimization, quantization, or latency profiling.
- Hearable, wearable, or hearing-protection integration.
- GDPR and on-device biometric data handling.
- Python for tooling and benchmarking.


Your first year

- Our Android SDK is integrated and validated on a smartphone OEM device, from PoC through NRE.
- Integration documentation hits v1.0 and speeds up onboarding for the next program.
- A second OEM integration is underway with clear milestones.
- Playbooks and templates are in place to support the Application Engineer hires planned for later in 2026.


Send your CV and motivation to work@whispp.com.

-  A deep learning researcher, with a track record in Language Models and/or RL (candidates with a Vision or Robotics ML background are also welcome to apply)

- Have a good understanding of graph algorithms
- Have some familiarity with model monitoring, git, build systems, and CI/CD
-  Respectful of others
-  Fluent in English 

Bonus Points



- Knowledge of approaches used in distributed training
- Familiarity with Triton
- Successful track-record in algorithms & data science contests
- Showing a code portfolio

Why You Should Apply



- Join an intellectually stimulating work environment
-  Be a pioneer: you get to work with a new type of "Live AI" challenges around long sequences and changing data
- Be part of one of an early-stage AI startup that believes in impactful research and foundational changes

title: Mechanical Engineer
text:
Team Summary

Our Mechanical Engineering team is responsible for driving innovation from the initial concept through to high-volume production for our key stakeholders' products. We serve as the vital integration hub, bridging the gap between various hardware disciplines, including Radio Frequency, Electrical Engineering, and Optics. Our lab is fully equipped with state-of-the-art tools for rapid prototyping, comprehensive testing, and advanced hardware development, offering a dynamic environment for hands-on engineering.

Job Summary

This role is designed for a self-guided Mechanical Engineer who enjoys driving mechanical innovation from the ground up. You will be responsible for navigating the most challenging aspects of the product development, from initial CAD modeling to design verification and field support. With an ownership mindset, you will guide mechanical components through iterative design cycles, managing everything from material selection to supplier coordination to ensure we deliver on quality, cost, and schedule.

Responsibilities and Duties



- Drive mechanical component development from initial concept to mass production, building high-fidelity CAD models, detailed drawings, and comprehensive BOMs
- Collaborate closely with Electrical, Firmware, and Optical engineers to ensure seamless cross-functional hardware integration and design performance
- Lead mechanical validation tests, such as fit, stress, and thermal analysis, and support design verification through iterative prototyping and lab testing
- Apply expert knowledge of DFM/DFA to optimize designs for performance, cost, and manufacturability
- Lead rigorous design reviews, risk assessments, and FMEAs while managing all engineering documentation and tolerance stack-up analysis
- Coordinate directly with suppliers and internal teams to ensure quality, cost, and schedule milestones are met
- Provide essential field support and lead iterative design improvements to maintain product excellence throughout its lifecycle.

Qualifications And Skills



- Proven experience in mechanical design, specifically within consumer electronics, IoT devices, or products with varying IP ratings
- Proficiency in CAD and CAE tools, specifically SolidWorks or PTC Creo
- Demonstrated track record of designing plastic parts for injection molding and selecting materials based on complex design requirements
- Deep technical understanding of mechanical design principles and GD&T based on ISO or ASME standards
- Skilled in performing rigorous tolerance stack-up analysis and using lab tools for hardware validation
- Strong work ethic and an ownership mindset, with the ability to communicate technical risks effectively to stakeholders
- At least an Intermediate level in both written and spoken English (B1).

We offer multiple benefits, that include



- The environment of equal opportunities, transparent and value-based corporate culture, and an individual approach to each team member
- Competitive salary packages with performance-based annual reviews
- Opportunity to receive a Performance Bonus for your individual achievements and a Loyalty Bonus recognizing your dedication to the company.
- Employment via Contract of Employment (UoP) in complete alignment with Polish Labour Law
- Guaranteed paid vacation, public holidays, and medical leaves as per statutory regulations
- Continuous growth and development opportunities through internal knowledge hubs, corporate courses, and free English classes
- Comprehensive private medical insurance to supplement your standard NFZ coverage.

title: Technolog CNC (tworzywa sztuczne)
text:

Dla naszego klienta z branży przetwórstwa tworzyw sztucznych poszukujemy doświadczonego Technologa CNC, który przejmie odpowiedzialność za planowanie i optymalizację procesów obróbki skrawaniem. - Dobór narzędzi skrawających, parametrów obróbki i przyrządów technologicznych dostosowanych do specyfiki tworzyw sztucznych,
- Tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technologicznej,
- Wyznaczanie i optymalizacja czasów technologicznych,
- Wsparcie techniczne dla operatorów maszyn CNC w trakcie produkcji,
- Nadzór nad przebiegiem procesów produkcyjnych oraz kontrola jakości detali,

✔️ Co Ci będzie potrzebne?

- Wykształcenie techniczne - preferowane kierunki: mechanika, budowa maszyn, mechatronika lub technologia tworzyw sztucznych,
- Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia na stanowisku technologa lub programisty CNC,
- Praktyczna znajomość obróbki skrawaniem tworzyw sztucznych (PA, POM, PEEK, PTFE, PC, ABS lub podobne),
- Doświadczenie w programowaniu CAM (PowerMill, EdgeCAM, Mastercam, SolidCAM lub inne),
- Bardzo dobra znajomość rysunku technicznego i tolerancji wymiarowych,


❓ Czego możesz się spodziewać, dołączając do nas?

- Kontraktu B2B lub UoP - decyzję pozostawiamy Tobie,
- Zespołu pracującego stacjonarnie w Jelcz-Laskowice,
- Prywatnej opieki medycznej - korzystamy z Luxmed,
- Dostępu do kafeterii MyBenefit, jako dofinansowanie do Multisporta 🏋️ lub punkty, które wymienisz na kupony zakupowe w Internecie,
- Prime Academy: dostęp do platform szkoleniowych (m.in. Coursera) + możliwość finansowania Twojego rozwoju w toku naszej współpracy,
- Prime Mobility: możliwości pracy przy projektach w ramach całej grupy Prime Group - mamy ponad 20 biur w Europie i na świecie (m.in. w Portugalii, Hiszpanii, Szwajcarii, Włoszech i Brazylii),
- Możliwości skorzystania z programu poleceń,
- Ubezpieczenia grupowego na życie.


Prime Engineering Poland jest częścią Prime Group, europejskiej grupy specjalizującej się w usługach z obszaru IT oraz inżynierii. Od ponad 18 lat budujemy i wspieramy na całym świecie zespoły w wielu branżach - od automotive, przez energetykę, aż po sektor finance/fintech. Od 2021 roku jesteśmy także w Polsce.
Kierujemy się zasadą: „Innovation first. People before that". Technologia jest ważna, ale nie bardziej niż ludzie, którzy za nią stoją. Nasz zespół stale rośnie - a Ty możesz do niego dołączyć. 😊

title: Inżynier / Inżynierka ds. Jakości Metod i Procesów
text:

W Alstom rozumiemy sieci transportowe i to, co porusza ludzi. Czy zostaniesz Inżynierem / Inżynierką ds. Jakości Metod i Procesów we Wrocławiu, którego / której szukamy?

Zakres obowiązków:



-  Opracowywanie i wdrażanie procesów, narzędzi oraz standardów jakości we współpracy z zespołami przemysłowymi. 
-  Zarządzanie działaniami związanymi z cyfrowymi narzędziami jakościowymi (GSI, QES, AOS). 
-  Prowadzenie szkoleń dla zespołów jakościowych z zakresu standardów jakości przemysłowej. 
-  Zarządzanie dokumentacją historii pojazdu („Car History Book”), w tym identyfikowalnością i konfiguracją wyrobów. 
-  Planowanie oraz realizacja audytów stanowisk pracy, monitorowanie działań korygujących i nadzorowanie planów działań. 
-  Koordynowanie działań związanych z metrologią oraz nadzorowanie współpracy z dostawcami usług kalibracyjnych. 
-  Zarządzanie zespołem metod jakościowych, jeśli wymaga tego organizacja. 
-  Koordynowanie planu doskonalenia APSYS w obszarze jakości przemysłowe j. 
-  Definiowanie, monitorowanie i analiza wskaźników jakościowych (KPI) oraz zapewnienie jakości danych. 
-  Przygotowywanie i aktualizacja miesięcznych raportów oraz dashboardów jakościowych. 
-  Prezentowanie wyników jakościowych, ryzyk oraz działań doskonalących podczas przeglądów zarządzania i spotkań biznesowych. 
-  Zapewnienie zgodności lokalnego raportowania jakościowego z wymaganiami i standardami centralnych struktur jakości. 
-  Wspieranie inicjatyw ciągłego doskonalenia poprzez analizę danych i monitorowanie wyników. 

Wymagania:



-  Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne. 
-  Doświadczenie w obszarze jakości, procesów produkcyjnych lub doskonalenia procesów. 
-  Znajomość narzędzi i metod zarządzania jakością. 
-  Umiejętność analizy danych oraz pracy z wskaźnikami jakościowymi. 
-  Umiejętność prowadzenia audytów procesowych lub stanowiskowych będzie dodatkowym atutem. 
-  Dobra znajomość pakietu MS Office, w szczególności programu Excel. 
-  Umiejętność przygotowywania raportów i prezentacji wyników. 
-  Zdolności analityczne oraz umiejętność rozwiązywania problemówUmiejętność pracy zespołowej i efektywnej komunikacji z różnymi interesariuszami. 
-  Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego min. C1. 

Dlaczego Alstom?

Alstom jest wiodącą firmą w sektorze kolejowym rozwiązującą najciekawsze wyzwania związanie z mobilnością.Dlatego cenimy dociekliwych i innowacyjnych ludzi, których pasją jest wspólna praca nad odkrywaniem mobilności na nowo czyniąc ją inteligentniejszą i bardziej zrównoważoną. Dzień po dniu budujemy zwinną, integracyjną i odpowiedzialną kulturę, w której zróżnicowanej grupie ludzi oferowane są możliwości uczenia się, rozwoju i awansu zawodowego, z opcjami obejmującymi różne funkcje i lokalizacje geograficzne.

title: Ustawiacz Procesu
text:
Oetiker gwarantuje naszym klientom pewność, że ich kluczowe komponenty są niezawodnie połączone. Nasza specjalistyczna wiedza i bogate doświadczenie w produkcji wysokojakościowych pierścieni, opasek zaciskowych, pasków i szybkozłączek obejmuje szeroki zakres zastosowań, od układów napędowych w pojazdach po rozwiązania medyczne. Nasz zakład produkcyjny w Polsce, który rozpoczął działalność w 2018 roku, dostarcza miliony wysokiej jakości opasek zaciskowych, pierścieni i szybkozłączy klientom w branży motoryzacyjnej.
